about_the_game:
Serega Madness is a story-driven horror adventure in the first-person action-adventure genre. This adventure combines with the fun design of horror games. Trapped in a Pixel World full of unknown creatures, the only way out is to face the darkness and find a way to escape. This is the first chapter of the Serega Madness story.

IN SEREGA MADNESS YOU WILL FEATURE:

  • Pixel world.

  • Serega - Hamster is a terribly cunning and downright creepy hamster, possessed by an evil spirit. He constantly haunts you.

  • Multiple chapters and puzzles.

  • Minigames and riddles.

  • Fights and chases.

  • Battles and much more!

WELCOME TO THE PIXEL WORLD

You've entered a pixel world—a place inhabited by a multitude of creatures. Entering this unknown world, you realize there's only one way out.

FIVE CHAPTERS, ONE ROAD TO SALVATION, AND MANY SECRETS!

Discover what lies hidden in this Pixel World. A gripping story awaits you that will keep you glued to the screen and breathtaking! Find an escape route from this unknown world, but don't forget that before leaving the Pixel World, you must fight Serega.

FEATURES:

  • Graphics: The game's cartoonish graphics create a cozy, adventurous atmosphere.

  • High Quality: AAA-quality graphics.

  • Unique Enemies: Each chapter features unique creatures with their own distinct artificial intelligence. Players will have to adapt their tactics to survive.

  • Dangerous Environment: Enemies aren't the only danger. The pixelated world is full of traps, obstacles, and other hazards to beware of.

THIS IS SEREGA MADNESS!

The horror adventure game Serega Madness will soon be available on Steam—with puzzles, battles, scenes, and graphics that will immerse you in a chilling adventure.

short_description: Serega Madness — is a single player horror adventure game set in a pixel world. Solve interesting puzzles while hiding from the insidious horrors waiting for you in the shadows.
